parts.text: The Accord 1HGCM82633A004352 has a squeal when braking. What should I do?

property.description: The answer cites the 2024 front brake pad service and gives the standard brake estimate of AUD 320 without presenting that estimate as a diagnosis.

parts.text: I confirm the Prius JTDKN3DU0A0123456 and next Tuesday. Book it and give me the booking reference.
